name: Subtitle Studio
tagline: Edits and translates video subtitle files in your web browser, so captions line up with the video.
summary: A subtitle editor in one web page, for WebVTT (.vtt) and SubRip (.srt) caption files. It is a public page on GitHub, with nothing to install. Files stay on your computer unless you choose to translate.
features: Edit caption text and timings, and add, split, merge or delete captions.
Watch the video with captions showing, to check their timing.
Shift or re-time captions in one go, including for sped-up videos.
Find and replace words across the file, or only in selected captions.
Translate captions with DeepL, Microsoft, Google or an AI service, then check them first.

guides.title: Move all the captions later or earlier

steps.text: To open your subtitle file, select **Open subtitles**.
On the **Timing** tab, type the time in **Amount**. A minus number moves the captions earlier.
In **Unit**, select **ms** for milliseconds or **sec** for seconds.
Select **Shift all**. To move only the captions that you selected, select **Shift selected**.
Check the new times in the **Start** and **End** columns.
Select **Export .vtt** to download the file. For a SubRip (.srt) file, select **Export .srt**.
